stemMd: Two similar solids have volumes in the ratio 8:27. What is the ratio of their corresponding lengths?
explanationMd: Volume scales with the cube of corresponding lengths. Taking cube roots of eight and twenty-seven gives the length ratio two to three.

distractorRationale.d: This is the corresponding area ratio.
distractorRationale.c: This squares rather than takes cube roots of the length ratio.
distractorRationale.e: This uses the volume ratio as the length ratio.
